create_Realtime3dComponent: create a Realtime3dComponent with a config to display live 3D point cloud data in a Dash app
build_Realtime3dComponentConfig: build a Realtime3dComponentConfig dataclass with a Plotly figure and update frequency settings for 3D visualization
register_callbacks_Realtime3dComponent: register Dash callbacks on a Realtime3dComponent to stream new 3D points and camera coordinates from the server
update_or_create_box_trace: update or create a 3D bounding box wireframe trace on a patched Plotly figure with custom color and linewidth
create_separate_box_traces: create separate 3D bounding box traces for each detected object class from the SVM watcher at a given observation index
